title: Lamp Profit SMP
description: The official collection of mods used on the Lamp Profit SMP.
body:
This is the modpack used within the Lamp Profit SMP. Every member was encouraged to pick a few mods to add to the server, and this is the complete modpack. None of the mods necessarilly were picked to work together, they were picked more to let each person have fun using the mods that they enjoy and give them a doorway into some potentially unfamiliar mods. We're hoping that with the release of our modpack, we can also give players of the included mods their own way into exploring other mods. The mods range from Quality-of-Life, such as AppleSkin and Comforts, mechanic overhauls, like Better Combat, and new additions, such as Create and Ice & Fire.

The complete list of mods within the modpack, is as follows,
